special3.name: Brotherhood of the Sword
special3.description: The Brotherhood of the Sword trains each visiting hero in Leadership.

configuration.visitedTooltip: This hero has already trained here.

rewards.message: The Brotherhood of the Sword permanently increases this hero's Leadership by 100.

special2.name: House of Wisdom
special2.description: The House of Wisdom sells a randomly generated selection of spell scrolls to visiting heroes.

special2.description: The Astral Nexus immediately replenishes each visiting hero's spell points to their normal maximum.

special2.name: Astronomy Tower
special2.description: The Astronomy Tower reveals the next Astrology Week one week before it begins.

special3.name: Library
special3.description: The Library increases weekly Mage and Arch Mage growth by 1. It no longer adds Mage Guild spells.

special4.name: Arcane Reservoir
special4.description: Once per week, the Arcane Reservoir can raise one visiting hero's current Mana to twice that hero's normal maximum.

rewards.message: The Arcane Reservoir doubles this hero's current Mana for the week.
